18.text: Google and Voltus expanded their agreement to build a 1 GW virtual power plant in the PJM grid, aggregating home and business energy for grid support and payments. Google also expanded AI partnerships with Accenture for federal Gemini agents and with Cognizant for agentic AI adoption.

6.text: Alphabet is expected to report Q3 earnings on Oct. 28, with analysts forecasting roughly $111.64 billion in revenue and $2.94 EPS, driven by Google Cloud growth (which accelerated to 82% in Q2) and Search advertising. Several articles debate valuation, rising capex, and free cash flow ahead of the report.

7.text: Anthropic’s IPO filing disclosed an $80.7B first-half 2026 net loss and over $600B in computing commitments, straining cloud providers and raising financing concerns. OpenAI is accelerating fundraising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO, while CoreWeave’s borrowing costs and a financing-driven AI selloff pressure Alphabet and peers.

11.text: Greg Abel, now Berkshire's CEO, is shifting its portfolio toward tech and AI, adding $330 million to Bending Spoons and trimming Buffett-era holdings like Visa and Amazon. Berkshire shares hit record highs and rose 10 straight days in October, driven by investor rotation out of AI stocks.

15.text: Market reports project edge AI software growing to $120.31 billion by 2032 and document AI to $35.34 billion by 2031, both profiling Google as a key player. Other articles cover military cloud, quantum error correction using Google hardware data, Nitro's Pax8 listing, and Canada's 5G device market, with minimal direct Alphabet impact.

16.text: SpaceX reported Q3 revenue of $14.6B (up 161% YoY), $4.4B net income, and its first operating profit, driven by AI revenue of $7.6B. Shares jumped over 10% on the results, and AI revenue surpassed Starlink for the first time, aided by reported deals with Anthropic and Google.

17.text: Marvell raised its fiscal 2028 revenue guidance to $20 billion and targets $70–90 billion by fiscal 2031, with record AI design wins and a multi-billion-dollar Google partnership. Analysts said a reported delay in Google's next AI chip won't hurt Marvell, though Taiwanese rivals threaten its margins.

5.text: Google and Unity are building an AI-powered game creation platform called Unity Spark, combining Google's AI research with Unity's engine. This partnership expands Google's AI ecosystem, indirectly supporting Alphabet's Gemini rollout through new consumer applications.

14.text: Google signed a 702-MW fuel-cell deal with Bloom Energy for a Wyoming data center and a power agreement with Black Hills for 2.7 GW through 2048. Both support Alphabet's AI data center energy needs.
